scope: New local competitive-style assessment on previously unplayed layouts in reviewed project records.

provenance.prior_sealed_suite: No independently sealed DoomRay suite was found in the inspected local inventory.
provenance.candidate_status: The training split and available training, development, holdout and diagnostic records do not report candidate gameplay. Earlier static audit rows exist, with no wrapper reset recorded.
provenance.limitations: Project records are not an exhaustive history of activity outside this workspace. Geometry and graph fingerprints are static and establish no engine reachability or difficulty outcomes.

tier_definitions.1: Combat and Survival: 12–26 placed monsters within 768 map units of spawn by straight-line distance. Measure survival, damage and real combat. Distance is not line-of-sight evidence.
tier_definitions.2: Multi-Room Exploration: 146–539 sectors, static sector-graph cycle ranks 41–193 and 2–13 nearby placed monsters. Focus on exploration and doors. Keys and combat can still occur.
tier_definitions.3: Long-Horizon Progression: at least four detected locked door sectors and two or more placed key colors. Record key, unlock and exit behavior. The required order of locks is unverified.
tier_definitions.4: Full Gauntlet: 503–777 sectors, 122–194 placed Skill 3 monsters, all three placed key colors and three detected locks. Resource scarcity and required backtracking are unverified.

episode_order: Tier order, map order as declared below, seed order, then C749, Stack-25-174 and Stack-26-621. Same engine and policy randomness seed. Preserve all attempted outcomes.
geometry_method: Axis rotation, reflection, translation and uniform scale normalized SHA-256 of raw line endpoints, sidedness and blocking. An eight-round sector adjacency graph fingerprint provides a second screen for re-indexing, minor wall/scale edits, and spawn variants. Both exclude things. These checks cannot exclude every transformation.
tick_cap_basis: Predeclared local horizons of 2100 ticks for the first two tiers and 4200 for progression and gauntlet. The organizer's private map limits are unknown.

excluded_layouts.reason: boss ending without a standard exit-lump signature
